notes.title: A Much-Needed Update on Unfriendly Friend
notes.notes:
Hey, friends!

We wanted to give you a quick but important update. The full version of Unfriendly Friend is in the works, and we're hoping to release it this autumn!

Stay tuned, as we'll be sharing more info as we get closer to the release. 


Thank you so much for being with us. I honestly never expected so many people to play Unfriendly Friend, and it means the world that so many of you are waiting for the full release. You are amazing. Thank you, truly.


Have a great day!
